# RNBO Guitar Pedals

A collection of classic guitar pedal effects made with RNBO, a library and toolchain that can take Max-like patches, export them as portable code, and directly compile that code to targets like a VST, a Max External, or a Raspberry Pi. 

In the package, you'll find some of the effects you might find in a guitar pedal rack, like an Overdrive, Flanger, Chorus, or WahWah. Those effects have been patched using RNBO and included in ready-to-export example patchers, exported Max externals, and Max For Live devices. 

This package is a great place to explore what's possible in RNBO, and has been designed for you to be able to use the effects in your own creations.

*The RNBO Guitar Pedals package is dedicated in memory of Darwin Grosse. This work would not have been possible without his encouragement, support, vision and insight.*
